string.text: CMS surgical kit

Compact surgical kit for treatment of bullet wounds and other serious injuries. Due to the rather basic and unsterile nature of these tools, a bandage is required to prevent bleeding during use.

Surv12 Field Surgical Kit

An advanced surgical kit with additional high-quality tools, allows treatment of serious injuries. Unlike the more common CMS kits in distribution, these instruments are both sterile and much more finely made, offering a much safer alternative for experienced stalkers.

Zagustin

Military issue drug. Inhibitis activators of profibinolysin and slows down its transformation in fibrinolysin. Temporarily stops bleeding and increases resistance to bloodloss. Has side effects. Leads to severe dehydration.
 
 %c[0,255,255,255]PROPERTIES:

 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] fast usage (syringe)
Army Bandage

An elastic army bandage used to stop bleeding and prevent infection of wounds. For regular bleeding, carefully apply the bandage to the wound. For arterial bleeding, urgently tie the bandage around the affected area.
 
 %c[0,255,255,255]PROPERTIES:
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] stops bleeding
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] fast usage (adhesive plaster)
Propital

Military issue drug. It stimulates regeneration processes by increasing the biosynthesis of purine and pyrimidine bases, RNA, functional and enzymatic cell elements. Increases metabolism, health and vitality. It has long-term side effects. Permitted for use only by medical officers and paramedics.

Combat stimulant. Mixed with a small amount of adrenalin it is used to increase the body abilities before combat for about 3 minutes. The stimulant is permitted for use by special forces units.
